review.notes: Accepted with fixes applied in place. Fixed: five same-layer forward references (targets reordered, one dependency dropped); eleven atlas stage ids `SR.0:abelian-category` in Needs replaced by the layer name; a false multiplicativity claim in positive-hecke-homomorphism (1) restricted to the torus case; the unnormalised second-adjointness right adjoint corrected from δ_P⁻¹ to δ_P (matching the conventions and SR.6); Iwahori decompositions now require both product orders and strong positivity is stated as in ACC; temperedness defined via exponents with a Konno locator because Casselman never states the tempered half; unsupported clauses removed from noetherian, bernstein-decomposition, finite-length (3), generic-irreducibility (discrete series), isotypic-quotient-regular; 14 wrong or incomplete locators corrected from the sources (BZ76 characters/twists, BZ77 length, Cas95 6.3.11/6.4.1/1.5.1/5.2.4, Ber92 pp. 45, 74–75, 86, Kon03 Cor. 3.2, FS I.5.1(v)/V.6.2/V.7.1, Ven arXiv pagination, TVpre pp. 29–31); non-key source names normalised to reference keys; process language removed; four uncited references dropped; Suggested.lean now imports Tau Ceti's Representation.baseChange instead of restating it, and its closing inventory no longer lists 13 names that are declared above it. Not verified: BD84 and Bor76 (scans without text), Lus89 (AMS blocked), BCGP, Pil, CT, CG20, Nak, AKY, Hel16, and the SR.4–SR.6 locators except TV/TVpre; SR.4–SR.6 prose is ASCII-math and uses layer-level Needs; geometric-trace-contract and essential-vector-contract are interface contracts rather than theorems. Duplication check against the current upstream roadmaps (incl. LocalGaloisGroups, ProfiniteArithmetic) and Tau Ceti a91d3aaf: no target already stated or implemented; two partial overlaps cited (HeckeCoset.heckeSum, HeckeRing.GL2.Newform.satakeParameters).
